parameters.query: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT flood_category FROM flood_observations WHERE source='NOAA_TIDE' AND station_id='8518750' ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1),'NONE') AS previous_category, COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('watch_id',watch_id,'display_name',display_name,'address',address,'fld_zone',fld_zone,'zone_subty',zone_subty,'sfha_tf',sfha_tf) ORDER BY display_name) FROM gis_watch_items_in_flood_zones()),'[]'::jsonb) AS watched;

WITH d AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j), o AS (SELECT j->'observation' AS o, j FROM d), ins AS (INSERT INTO flood_observations(source,station_id,observed_at,water_level_mhhw_ft,predicted_level_mhhw_ft,flood_category,title,payload) SELECT o->>'source',o->>'station_id',(o->>'observed_at')::timestamptz,(o->>'water_level_mhhw_ft')::double precision,NULLIF(o->>'predicted_level_mhhw_ft','')::double precision,o->>'flood_category',o->>'title',COALESCE(o->'payload','{}'::jsonb) FROM o ON CONFLICT(source,station_id,observed_at) DO UPDATE SET water_level_mhhw_ft=EXCLUDED.water_level_mhhw_ft,predicted_level_mhhw_ft=EXCLUDED.predicted_level_mhhw_ft,flood_category=EXCLUDED.flood_category,title=EXCLUDED.title,payload=EXCLUDED.payload RETURNING id), h1 AS (INSERT INTO source_health(source_id,status,last_attempt_at,last_success_at,last_event_at,last_error,metadata,updated_at) SELECT 'NOAA_TIDE','OK',now(),now(),(o->>'observed_at')::timestamptz,NULL,jsonb_build_object('station_id','8518750','thresholds',j->'thresholds','watched_count',j->'watched_count'),now() FROM o ON CONFLICT(source_id) DO UPDATE SET status='OK',last_attempt_at=now(),last_success_at=now(),last_event_at=EXCLUDED.last_event_at,last_error=NULL,metadata=EXCLUDED.metadata,updated_at=now() RETURNING source_id), h2 AS (INSERT INTO source_health(source_id,status,last_attempt_at,last_success_at,last_event_at,last_error,metadata,updated_at) SELECT 'NWS_FLOOD','OK',now(),now(),CASE WHEN COALESCE((j->>'nws_active_count')::integer,0)>0 THEN now() ELSE NULL END,NULL,jsonb_build_object('active_alerts',COALESCE((j->>'nws_active_count')::integer,0),'point','40.7690,-74.0200','watched_count',j->'watched_count'),now() FROM d ON CONFLICT(source_id) DO UPDATE SET status='OK',last_attempt_at=now(),last_success_at=now(),last_event_at=CASE WHEN COALESCE((EXCLUDED.metadata->>'active_alerts')::integer,0)>0 THEN now() ELSE source_health.last_event_at END,last_error=NULL,metadata=EXCLUDED.metadata,updated_at=now() RETURNING source_id) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ins) AS observation_rows,(SELECT count(*) FROM h1) AS noaa_health,(SELECT count(*) FROM h2) AS nws_health;

parameters.jsCode: const batch = $('Build Standard Flood Alerts').first().json || {}; const alerts = Array.isArray(batch.alerts) ? batch.alerts : []; return alerts.map(alert => ({json: alert}));

parameters.query: WITH d AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j), upserted AS (INSERT INTO alerts(schema_version,alert_id,source,source_event_id,category,subtype,status,event_action,title,message,priority,county,municipality,location,tags,click_url,source_url,observed_at,source_updated_at,received_at,expires_at,metadata,raw_payload,search_text,geom,updated_at) SELECT COALESCE(j->>'schema_version','1.0'),j->>'alert_id',j->>'source',NULLIF(j->>'source_event_id',''),j->>'category',j->>'subtype',j->>'status',j->>'event_action',j->>'title',j->>'message',(j->>'priority')::integer,NULLIF(j->>'county',''),NULLIF(j->>'municipality',''),COALESCE(j->'location','{}'::jsonb),ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(j->'tags','[]'::jsonb))),NULLIF(j->>'click_url',''),NULLIF(j->>'source_url',''),NULLIF(j->>'observed_at','')::timestamptz,NULLIF(j->>'source_updated_at','')::timestamptz,COALESCE(NULLIF(j->>'received_at','')::timestamptz,now()),NULLIF(j->>'expires_at','')::timestamptz,COALESCE(j->'metadata','{}'::jsonb),j,NULLIF(j->>'search_text',''),CASE WHEN NULLIF(j->'location'->>'latitude','') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(j->'location'->>'longitude','') IS NOT NULL THEN ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint((j->'location'->>'longitude')::double precision,(j->'location'->>'latitude')::double precision),4326) ELSE NULL END,now() FROM d ON CONFLICT(alert_id) DO UPDATE SET status=EXCLUDED.status,event_action=EXCLUDED.event_action,title=EXCLUDED.title,message=EXCLUDED.message,priority=EXCLUDED.priority,county=EXCLUDED.county,municipality=EXCLUDED.municipality,location=EXCLUDED.location,tags=EXCLUDED.tags,click_url=EXCLUDED.click_url,source_url=EXCLUDED.source_url,observed_at=EXCLUDED.observed_at,source_updated_at=EXCLUDED.source_updated_at,expires_at=EXCLUDED.expires_at,metadata=EXCLUDED.metadata,raw_payload=EXCLUDED.raw_payload,search_text=EXCLUDED.search_text,geom=EXCLUDED.geom,updated_at=now() RETURNING id::text AS alert_db_uuid) SELECT d.j AS alert,upserted.alert_db_uuid FROM d CROSS JOIN upserted;
